subject: Azure Partner Center referrals — coverage gaps for Acme & seller alignment
summary: Identify and reconcile mismatches between Redwood account mapping and Partner Center referrals for Acme; align field sellers and agree next steps for co-sell handoff.
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Azure Co-sell Team <azure-cosell@microsoft.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center referrals — coverage gaps for Acme & seller alignment

Team / Azure,

Quick context: we received a Partner Center referral for Acme yesterday (REF-12345) but when I reconciled the referral owners against our account mapping we see two areas of mismatch:

- The referral lists a west-coast field seller (Microsoft: Luis Ramos) while our CRM shows Acme owned by our East coast AE, Sarah Nolan on Acme side confirmed the regional engagement is with East.
- A set of mid-market accounts under the Acme parent are absent from the referral payload (looks like a territory split in Partner Center).

Attachments: I attached an "acme_account_map_v2.xlsx" with our canonical account roster and a quick "mkt_territory_sketch.png" showing how we bucketed accounts for Dedicated capacity outreach.

Asks:
1) Azure — can you validate which Partner Center seller is queued on REF-12345 and whether the missing child accounts can be added to the referral?
2) Marissa / Jonas — can you confirm the internal owner mappings (AE/AM/CS) we should use for co-sell handoff? I highlighted the three ambiguous accounts in the spreadsheet (rows 12–14).
3) Can we set a 30-min alignment call (this week) with the Partner Center referral owner + our AE to avoid duplicates and ensure the co-sell plan points to the correct seller?

Proposed next step: if Azure confirms the seller mismatch, we ask for a reassignment to our East seller or explicit write-up of the territory split so we can route the deal to the right AE.

Thanks — want to move fast to avoid a stale referral.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Sales | Redwood Inference
(k) +1 415-555-0123
[karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com]

---
Attachments: acme_account_map_v2.xlsx (xlsx), mkt_territory_sketch.png (image)

From: Liam Harper <liam.harper@microsoft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Azure Co-sell Team <azure-cosell@microsoft.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referrals — coverage gaps for Acme & seller alignment

Thanks Karthik — I pulled up REF-12345. Short notes:

- Current referral owner: Luis Ramos (MSFT, West Region). That was auto-assigned by Partner Center based on the enterprise account mapping on their side.
- The referral payload currently contains only the top-level Acme parent; child accounts require explicit mapping in Partner Center (we sometimes miss mid-market subsidiaries).

I can do two things right away:
1) Open an edit request on REF-12345 to add the three child accounts you flagged (I will need the internal account IDs you have in the spreadsheet).
2) If you confirm an East-coast AE should own the co-sell, I can reassign the referral to the MSFT AE you indicate, or set the referral to be shared (co-owned) so both sellers see it.

Available for a 30-min call tomorrow 9–11am PT or Thursday 10–12pm PT.

—Liam
Liam Harper
Senior Partner PM, Azure Co-sell
Microsoft Corporation
liam.harper@microsoft.com

---
(Attachment: Partner Center referral snapshot - REF-12345 [link provided in thread])

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam Harper <liam.harper@microsoft.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referrals — coverage gaps for Acme & seller alignment

Karthik / Liam —

Thanks — quick clarifications from our side after I reviewed the spreadsheet:
- The three ambiguous child accounts are Acme-SS (row 12, internal id ACME-SS-34), Acme-IntlOps (row 13, ACME-IO-07), and Acme-PartnerServices (row 14, ACME-PS-19). I added the internal IDs to acme_account_map_v2.xlsx in column H.
- Internal ownership: our AE on file is Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com) for Acme parent and Acme-PartnerServices. Acme-SS historically had a different AE but that relationship is being transferred to Jonas as of last quarter; CRM hasn't fully propagated.

On the field alignment call: Jonas and I are available Thursday 10:30–11:00am PT. If Liam can put the Partner Center owner and the MSFT AE on, we can do a quick handoff and decide whether to reassign or mark the referral as co-owned.

Suggested agenda (15–20 minutes):
- Confirm final account roster for the referral (Liam to confirm additions)
- Decide referral ownership: reassign or co-owned
- Confirm next steps for co-sell enablement (sharing seller contacts, brief discovery slot, MOPs)

Jonas — assigning to you to confirm the internal AE handoff and be on the call.

—Marissa

Cc: Azure Co-sell Team <azure-cosell@microsoft.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referrals — coverage gaps for Acme & seller alignment

Thanks everyone — quick recap and agreed actions from today's exchange (Jonas joined the call and we confirmed the following):

- Liam will submit an edit to REF-12345 to add the three child accounts (ACME-SS-34, ACME-IO-07, ACME-PS-19) and will confirm when the Partner Center payload is updated (target: EOD Friday PT).
- Microsoft will reassign the referral to the East AE (name: Priya Desai, MSFT AE) with co-owner visibility for Luis Ramos to preserve any prior engagement.
- Jonas (internal AE) will be the Redwood point for the co-sell and will schedule 30-min discovery with Acme next week; Jonas to add notes to HubSpot record and tag the referral (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765).
- Marissa will update our CRM mapping and mark the transfer of Acme-SS to Jonas. Updated spreadsheet attached (acme_account_map_v2.xlsx).

Next steps (owners / deadlines):
- Liam: confirm Partner Center edit completed (REF-12345) — due 2026-09-17 EOD PT.
- Jonas: schedule discovery with Acme and share calendar invite — due 2026-09-20.
- Marissa: update CRM and confirm account ownership propagation — due 2026-09-18.

If any of these timelines slip, flag in this thread and we will escalate to the MSFT Partner PM. Thanks to Liam for the quick turn.

—Karthik
